WITH low_employment_majors AS (
    -- First, let's identify majors with low employment rates (< 50% within first year)
    SELECT 
        major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as total_graduates,
        COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) as employed_graduates,
        (COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id)) as employment_rate
    FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala u
    LEFT JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j 
        ON u.id = j.id 
        AND j.job_start_date BETWEEN u.graduation_date AND DATE_ADD(u.graduation_date, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
    WHERE u.graduation_date >= DATE_SUB(CAST('2026-03-03' AS DATE), INTERVAL 5 YEAR)
        AND u.qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')
        AND u.graduation_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY major_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) >= 10  -- Ensure sufficient sample size
    AND (COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id)) < 50
),
top_jobs_in_low_employment_majors AS (
    -- Then find the most common jobs for graduates from these majors
    SELECT 
        j.job_title,
        COUNT(*) as job_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j
    INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala u 
        ON j.id = u.id
    INNER JOIN low_employment_majors lem 
        ON u.major_name = lem.major_name
    WHERE j.job_start_date BETWEEN u.graduation_date AND DATE_ADD(u.graduation_date, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
        AND j.job_start_date >= DATE_SUB(CAST('2026-03-03' AS DATE), INTERVAL 5 YEAR)
    GROUP BY j.job_title
    ORDER BY job_count DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT job_title, job_count
FROM top_jobs_in_low_employment_majors
ORDER BY job_count DESC
